definition: 100 volume-pass epochs * 10 batch-one updates/epoch * measured SegResNet-12 Dice-only update cost
accounting: Declared training arithmetic: forward, loss, backward and optimizer; dense MAC=2. Validation, preprocessing/augmentation, I/O and precision housekeeping excluded consistently.
selection_basis: User selected SegResNet-12 and reduced its reference horizon to 100 epochs. The cap was not selected from constraint outcomes.
baseline_validation_status: Measured on fold0 seed0: final85.95294%, best85.96393%; both exceed the desired70–80% range. Budget remains the user-selected cap; no target-achieving budget has been inferred.
constraints_accounting: Profile each augmented objective and charge all training-only weight calibration within this same cap before deriving its maximum updates.
checkpoint_schedule_policy: Learning-rate and validation schedules must use the new update limits; do not treat an intermediate checkpoint of a longer-horizon run as a newly trained endpoint.
